info.title: deployify
info.description: Deploy .NET Aspire AppHost projects to Nomad, Kubernetes, Helm, GitOps, Docker Compose, AWS ECS or Azure Container Apps.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: deployify – deploy .NET Aspire AppHost projects to any target (Nomad, Kubernetes, Compose, …)

options.description: Show help and usage information

commands.name: init
commands.description: Initialize deployify in an Aspire AppHost project.

options.name: --project-path
options.description: Path to the Aspire AppHost .csproj or its directory. [default: <path>]

options.name: --non-interactive
options.description: Disable interactive prompts; fail on missing required values. [default: False]

options.name: --env-name
options.description: Environment name. [default: local]

options.name: --target
options.description: Deployment target: nomad | kubernetes | helm | argocd | flux | ovhcloud | compose | awsecs | azurecontainerapps | nomadconsul | iis | cloudrun | host, or the ID of a plugin target.

options.name: --container-registry
options.description: Container registry URL.

options.name: --image-tag
options.description: Default image tag. [default: latest]

options.name: --output-path
options.description: Output folder for artifacts. [default: deployify-output]

options.name: --container-runtime
options.description: Container runtime for publishing: docker (default) | podman. [default: Docker]

options.name: --container-os
options.description: Target OS for container images (default: linux). [default: linux]

options.name: --container-arch
options.description: Target CPU architecture for container images: x64 (default) | arm64 | arm. [default: x64]

options.name: --deploy-dapr

options.name: --dapr-version

options.name: --dapr-http-port

options.name: --deploy-dashboard
options.description: Inject the Aspire Dashboard container into every deployment. [default: False]

options.name: --dashboard-tag
options.description: Image tag for mcr.microsoft.com/dotnet/aspire-dashboard. [default: latest]

options.name: --dashboard-port

options.name: --dashboard-otlp-port
options.description: Host port for the OTLP gRPC endpoint. [default: 18889]

options.name: --dashboard-token

options.name: --nomad-address

options.description: User to connect as. WinRM reads the password from IIS_PASSWORD.

options.description: User to connect as; on Linux the services run as this user too. WinRM reads the password from HOST_PASSWORD.

options.description: Folder on the hosts for the services and their releases. Default: /opt/deployify or C:\deployify.

commands.name: apply
commands.description: Deploy to the target.

options.name: --project-path
options.description: Path to the Aspire AppHost .csproj or its directory. [default: <path>]

options.name: --env
options.description: Environment to use, overriding the active environment (e.g. local, prod).

options.name: --target
options.description: Deployment target: nomad | kubernetes | helm | argocd | flux | ovhcloud | compose | awsecs | azurecontainerapps | nomadconsul | iis | cloudrun | host, or the ID of a plugin target.

options.name: --allow-unverified
options.description: Start target plugins that deployify-plugins.lock.json has no hash for, with a warning each time (a plugin whose files don't match its locked hash is still refused). Run 'deployify plugin lock' instead to verify them. [default: False]

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Simulate the operation without making changes. [default: False]

options.name: --strict
options.description: Fail when the manifest has resources Deployify won't deploy, even if nothing depends on them (list the ones you expect under ignoreResources). [default: False]

options.name: --auto-approve
options.description: Skip confirmation prompt. [default: False]

options.name: --image-tag
options.description: Deploy this image tag instead of the environment's configured tag, for example one promoted from another environment.

options.name: --require-digest
options.description: Fail instead of deploying a built image by tag when no published digest is recorded for it (for example after 'deployify promote'). [default: False]

options.name: --require-signature
options.description: Fail unless every image the environment builds is pinned by digest and has a cosign signature that the environment's signing settings trust (signing.publicKey, or signing.identity and signing.issuer). Needs cosign. [default: False]

options.name: --no-health-gate
options.description: Deploy without waiting for services to become healthy and without automatic rollback. [default: False]

options.name: --no-rollback
options.description: Wait for health, but leave a failed deployment in place instead of rolling it back. [default: False]

options.name: --health-timeout
options.description: Seconds each service may take to become healthy before the rollout fails (default: 600). [default: 600]

options.name: --rollback-timeout
options.description: Seconds the whole rollback may take (default: 900). [default: 900]

options.name: --prune
options.description: After a successful deploy, remove services that are no longer in the manifest (only ones Deployify deployed and still marks as its own). [default: False]

options.name: --force-prune
options.description: Prune even when it would remove more than half of the services, or all of them. [default: False]
